leadText: Tsubasa (Japanese: ツバサ Tsubasa) is a young boy in the series How I Became a Pokémon Card. He lives in a small village which holds a contest to determine which villager will be known as the "Air Master", or the ultimate Trainer of bird . Tsubasa wants to become an Air Master, but has no Pokémon of his own, so he attempts to train his grandfather's , which does not take to him. He competes against Takaya and his .
